entries.header: theorem M7.Selection.win_sound_complete : ∀ (α : Type) (T : Finset α) (feasible : α → Prop) (R : α → α → Prop) (x : α), x ∈ M7.Selection.winners T feasible R ↔ x ∈ T ∧ feasible x ∧ ∀ y ∈ T, feasible y → ¬ R y x

entries.header: theorem M7.Selection.finite_extreme : ∀ (α : Type) (T : Finset α) (R : α → α → Prop), (∀ x, ¬ R x x) → (∀ x y z, R x y → R y z → R x z) → ∀ x ∈ T, ∃ y ∈ T, (∀ z ∈ T, ¬ R z y) ∧ (y = x ∨ R y x)
